profiles.name: Alfred Fattig
profiles.finding: Publisher's Madstone page and sample identify the Oregon conscientious objector (1892–1990). Sample provides family history and imprisonment evidence but no individually verified usable portrait was recovered. Alfred Henry Fattig (1897–1988) and Orville Alfred Fattig are not verified matches. Book cover is not accepted as a portrait. Full book/family photo collection remains an unresolved lead.

profiles.name: Charles Savannah Fattig
profiles.finding: Madstone publisher and sample confirm Charlie as Alfred's elder brother and fellow Oregon draft resister; catalog identifies Charles Fattig (1889–1967). Charlie Fattig (1915–1973) genealogy hit rejected. Trail-restoration photographs depict contemporary volunteers, not the prisoner. No individually identified portrait recovered; full book and family collection remain leads.

rights_notes: Publisher sample states copyright 2018 Paul Fattig, all rights reserved; cover photograph credited to Jim Craven. No image reuse authorization inferred.
next_run: Advance to unattempted names; retain Fattig book/family archive leads as unresolved. Obtain storage health inventory for nonblank portraits before claiming broken-asset coverage.
